ns2:section.sectionText: Topic: Journalists in Popular Culture This class will examine depictions of journalists in movies, TV shows, and other media over the past century - depictions that are at once repellent and romantic, villainous and heroic—and it will consider their implications for the news media, the public, and democracy. For Chancellor's Scholars only. Others may only enroll with the consent of the instructor and the Campus Honors Program. **Freshman are restricted from enrolling in this course.
